**[P2] Preserve earlier invocation boundaries in terminal roots**

This end time uses a fresh wall anchor on every resume, while reset discards the previous boundary. If wall time moves backward between invocations handled by the same plugin instance, the terminal `Workflow` and `DurableExecutionRoot` end before the first `Invocation`; the negative-wall-step test skips that assertion even when `freshPlugin` is false. Track a per-execution maximum boundary across resets and clamp terminal roots to it. Apply the same fix to `ExecutionOtelPlugin`, while retaining the documented cross-container limitation.
